sections.heading: Connect assets, data and operations
sections.body:
Energy and mining organisations need a clear view of assets, materials and operational performance. Linkfields connects digital platforms, automation and analytics to support maintenance planning, supply chains and day-to-day decisions.

Across mining and Oil & Gas, we bring operational information into connected workflows while considering security from the start. From material management to terminal operations, we shape technology around the work your teams need to do.
